messages:
Rae: Quick RFC: regroup left nav into task buckets (Author -> Deploy -> Observe). Mock linked. Main constraints: keep resource permalinks stable, make breadcrumbs more useful, and fix a11y announcements. Thoughts?

Miro: Agree on task buckets. Permalinks must not change — keep canonical `/console/models/:id`. UI state should map to `?bucket=deploy`.

Samir: I'm worried about docs and external links. Any change should provide redirects: legacy `/console/models/:id/overview` -> `/console/models/:id?bucket=author&panel=overview`. Preserve utm/ref query params.

Leah: Accessibility: when buckets switch announce "Now in Deploy" via a polite live region and move focus to the container's first focusable item. Add `aria-expanded` on toggles and `aria-current="true"` on active items.

NavBot: /audit left-nav -> Missing `aria-expanded` on 2 toggles; no live region found. Recommend `role=region` + `aria-live=polite` for bucket content; add `aria-controls` linking toggles to panels.

Rae: Breadcrumb copy: current: "Models / 88". Proposal: "Models 7 ImageGen v2.1" (show version). Clamp at 44 chars, reveal full name on hover/long-press. Mobile: compact to "ImageGen v2.1".

Miro: For deep anchors, use `#panel=inputs` and map on load with `history.replaceState` so back-button isn't polluted. Small shim in router handles this.

Samir: Analytics: normalize events to emit a synthetic path `/console/models/:id/bucket/deploy` so dashboards ignore query variance. Tests for utm preservation in redirects.

Leah: Also ensure when we programmatically focus a panel we call `announceForAccessibility('Panel: ' + label)` and clear the live region after 700ms to avoid repeated reads. Add unit tests verifying `aria-current` toggles.

Rae: Action items: 1) Redirects + analytics mapping (Samir), 2) Router hash->query shim + tests (Miro), 3) A11y attrs + live region + axe run (Leah). Sync Tue 11am. Loom: https://loom.com/share/nav-rfc-demo.

Miro: I'll open a PR with the router adapter and migration notes, include examples of legacy -> canonical rewrites. ETA Mon afternoon.

Samir: I'll draft the redirects and analytics normalization, add tests for utm retention.

Leah: I'll add ARIA attrs and run `axe-core`, then paste results here. Will add a tiny Playwright E2E for keyboard focus.

NavBot: Reminder scheduled: Tue 11:00am. Invite sent. :calendar:
